I'm sorry, but the price-drop policy doesn't cover this. Our price drop adjustment (the difference as store credit, available within 7 days of purchase) specifically excludes flash sales and clearance items. Since your snake plant is cheaper because of a flash sale, I can't offer the difference, even though you're within the 7-day window.

If you feel this should be an exception, I can escalate your request to a Support Lead for review, though I can't promise the outcome. Would you like me to do that?
